Maya: Quick decision needed	we need a 3-tier intake mapping for incoming design partners (Standard / Fasttrack / Concierge). Can we ship a deterministic rule set today?
Jon: Prefer deterministic for now. main risk is Fasttrack capacity.
Priya: Propose signals: QPS bucket, data sensitivity (PII/reg), and integration effort (dev hours).
Sam: QPS buckets: <1k, 1k-10k, >10k. PII=true => Concierge. If >10k and effort<40h => Fasttrack. effort>=40h => Concierge.
Elena: UX: show reason copy inline: "Matched to Concierge due to regulated data." include contact link.
Maya: Add a global feature flag to force "all Standard" for 24h as rollback.
Jon: I'll implement `POST /v1/intake/route` returning {"route":"Fasttrack","reason":"QPS>10k"} and a feature-flag switch. PR -> recruitment/routing-service.
OpsBot: Staging routing table updated 2026-03-24T14:00Z. endpoint: /intake/simulate-route
Priya: Metrics week1: acceptance rate >65%, onboarding drop-off <25%, time-to-first-success <72h. Also track route churn by partner id.
Maya: Owners: Jon (routing + flag, ETA tomorrow EOD), Priya (sim dataset + dashboard, ETA Tue), Elena (invite copy, ETA today), Sam (confirm GPU slots, ETA EOD). Reopen when PR posted. :raised_hands:
